findings.summary: `opts = PdfPipelineOptions()` followed by `opts.do_ocr = False` can be a single line: `opts = PdfPipelineOptions(do_ocr=False)` (PdfPipelineOptions is a pydantic model, confirmed against docling 2.102.1 source). Same logic, one fewer line.
